Welcome to The Lighthouse Inn
Welcome to the Lighthouse Inn at Aransas Bay, a bayside gem on the beautiful Texas Coast. Relax and enjoy boutique accommodations with modern amenities, a commitment to exceptional service and breathtaking waterfront scenery. You can’t get any closer to the water on the Coastal Bay!
Featuring a Victorian era design with a sparkling white exterior and genuine period finishes, the Inn features 78 spacious guestroom and suite accommodations, each offering a private balcony or patio. Whether you are traveling for business or leisure, choose the Lighthouse Inn for our unbeatable value, luxurious accommodations, and warm and friendly staff.
Fishing
We work with more than 200 fishing guides in the area.

Rockport Country Club Golf Course
This par 71, 18-hole 6500 yard championship golf course was designed by Bill Coore and features a slope rating of 119-125 amid 65 acres of lovely lakes and ponds hosting plentiful wildlife.

Texas State Aquarium
Visit the Texas State Aquarium to enjoy daily feedings, training sessions, dive shows and hands-on programs with creatures including stingrays and sharks.

Rockport Beach
Offering a full range of onsite facilities, Rockport Beach is open to the public from 6:00 am to 11:00 pm Sunday thru Thursday and 6:00 am to Midnight on Friday and Saturday.

"Right on the water. Great views and lovely staff 5/5!
Wonderful views of the Bay sitting on your balcony enjoying the off shore breezes. Walk to many restaurants and attractions. Very friendly staff and beautiful gathering area. You are right on the water and all that goes with it. Onsite restaurant is excellent."
February 2024
"Serene hotel with great location 5/5!
Beautiful location on the water. Great choice of local restaurants within walking distance. Fantastic breakfast. Hot coffee and tea all day. Our room was large and had an - unexpected - full kitchen. Highly suggest a room overlooking the bay. Enjoyed rocking on our porch during the sunrise. Only a short drive to Port Aransas and Corpus Christi."
October 2023
"Best ever 5/5!
Wonderful location!! Great room! Really great sunrise and sunsets! Sitting on the dock watching the tide roll in is the greatest! One stop location great bar, restaurant, pool, etc. Walking distance to lots of great food! Will definitely be back."
September 2023
"WONDERFUL 5/5!!
This hotel has it all! The Staff is top notch, exceptionally friendly and were a wealth of information regarding restaurants etc. There is a lovely bar and restaurant off of the lobby with
great views of the bay. Our breakfast, which is included with your reservation, was delicious and definitely an upgrade from the regular fare served at most hotels.
You can enjoy it in the restaurant or bring a plate to your room and eat on the balcony which ours had 2 very comfortable rocking chairs.
Beds are comfy, rooms are nicely appointed and well air conditioned.
Thank you so much for your relaxing and lovely accommodations as we enjoyed our time in Rockport.
WE WILL BE BACK!!❤️"
September 2023
"Great Place to Stay 5/5!
This hotel is a great place to stay. The staff is very friendly and professional and willing to make your stay very enjoyable. The room was exactly what we requested and was very clean. Beds were comfortable and we loved sitting on the balcony and relaxing overlooking the water. The weather was too cold to swim in the pool; however, rooms overlooking the pool also have a great view. Breakfast was tasty the 2 mornings we were there and coffee is always available in the lobby, as well as in your room. We will definitely stay there again!"
February 2023

Deluxe Guestrooms & Suites at the Lighthouse Inn in Rockport, TX
Guests at the Lighthouse Inn may choose from 36 deluxe guestrooms or 42 spacious suites, each featuring a private balcony or patio complete with two rocking chairs to better enjoy pool and garden or outstanding bay views. Offering the perfect balance of luxury and convenience, guestroom amenities include extra perks such as coffee service, upscale bath products and complimentary high-speed Internet.

Contact & Location
Rockport, Texas is easily reached by car or plane. Travelers enjoy easy access to the Lighthouse Inn from the Aransas County Airport, and Corpus Christi International Airport is just 35 miles away. Houston, Katy, Victoria, Austin and San Antonio are also just a short drive away. Onsite parking is complimentary for our guests, and boat and trailer parking is available across the street.
The Lighthouse Inn at Aransas Bay
Feel free to contact us with any questions or for more information about our unique boutique hotel in Texas. We look forward to hearing from you!

Rockport History
Rockport, named for the rock ledge beneath its shore, began development as a cattle processing and shipping port in 1865 after the Civil War and was incorporated in 1871. During the 1880s boat building and fishing industries began to develop, and in 1886 the San Antonio and Aransas Pass Railway was brought in by local cattle raisers, including the Fulton, Mathis and Coleman families.
Tourism and resort trade began to flourish and in 1890, and Rockport gained electric lights. Interest in constructing a deep-water harbor in Rockport started in 1884 and continued through 1921, but in the end President Harding signed a bill for a port at Corpus Christi instead. A harbor was eventually built at Rockport in 1935, and a shipyard was established in 1941 where submarine-chasing speedboats were built.
In 1919 a hurricane nearly obliterated Rockport and recovery was slow. The shrimping industry developed in the late 1920s when the boat-building trade also picked up. Today, fishing, shrimp and tourism are Rockport’s driving economic forces. Visitors can fish, swim, bird watch, and enjoy other countless  attractions  including Goose Island, the Fulton Mansion, the annual Rockport Art Festival, Seafair and the Rockport Art Center.
